source.notes: Passes computed using NASA NAIF SPICE (spiceypy 8.4.0) with topocentric elevation above local horizon on a spherical Mars (radius 3396190 m, IAU_MARS body-fixed frame). min_elevation_deg = 10.0 is an assumed communication elevation mask (no published minimum mask found in relay literature). MAVEN excluded (mission ended Dec 2025). TGO forward predicted trajectory extends through 2026-12-19 per latest ESA/NAIF publication.
